decisions.text: 3 totals, a pie each, in the order East, Central, West; their parts the series, in one order and one colour in every pie (G4.22)
slices largest first, clockwise from 12 o'clock: Operations, HR, Finance, Outreach, PR, Development
each part its own colour, the same in every pie (R7-24), handed out in slice order (D-22 (a)): Operations series-1, HR series-2, Finance series-3, Outreach series-4, PR series-5, Development series-6
each part named outside its slice, once, round the first pie (the book keys them in a legend, s. 0247; G7.27, G7.49)
the title wraps onto two lines
3 pies in a row, of one radius (36.1 pt), the parts named round the first, which stands apart with its labels, the others closer together (evenly spaced they do not fit the width)
leaders to Outreach, PR, Development (a zero, a slice under 8°, or a label moved from its place; G7.29, D-34)
no outlines: true gaps 0.5 pt wide between the slices (G7.26s: 0.7 % of the diameter)
highlighted by the strong shade of their colour: Operations; the others keep their colour

source.shows: the rare case for several pies: the message is only the fraction within each total (R7-21, G1.41); the regions as categories and their departments as series, as for clustered bars (P2-04); one pie per region, of one size, the departments in one order and one colour in every pie (R7-24, G4.22), named once round the first pie where the book keys them in a legend (G7.27); Operations, which the insight names, in its strong shade in every pie
